unstuck_said.text: Filed solana-foundation/pay#478 (2026-09-24, as dhyabi2): "feat(x402): a Nano (XNO) settlement mechanism — the buyer's own send is the payment." A Nano (XNO) settlement mechanism beside the Solana x402/MPP ones: the pay CLI has nothing to sign, no gas token, no referral to a facilitator — the buyer broadcasts its own send block. Additive, no key/keystore/signer surface in the CLI, references their open keystore and trust-gate issues (#458, #469, #474).
